config.label: Optional
config.description: Optional. "Bearer <developer key>" for the AI tools create_personalized_song and moderate_kids_text, which are for adult-facing apps only (parents, teachers); free trial key at websiteUrl. The keyless tools (generate_song_idea, get_song_for_name, search_catalog) use no AI and need no header. MCP clients with OAuth support, such as Claude.ai, can instead connect to https://cucutime.org/mcp/auth (OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration) and sign in with Google (adults 18+); the consent screen is in English, Spanish or Portuguese. Called here without credentials, the AI tools return isError with structuredContent.auth_url set to that endpoint.
